still._prompt_jet_note: First sweep (work/drone/shaded/): 'drone, flying drone, robot, sci-fi, concept art' drew fighter jets with red fins, every seed. The look wants a disc with a rotor above and a lens below.
still._chosen_note: saucer seed 1, cropped to its left half (the model also drew a helicopter beside it): a flat disc with a rotor mast on top and a red lens glowing on the underside, in clean profile. The gun barrel is not drawn; it is a small part cut from the mast (see rig).

target._settings_note: Dani's target block; the still is 30 art px tall before the rotor and mast are squashed (see rig), which puts the disc at ~25 art px wide and the whole drone at ~18 tall, the cast.md table's 28x18, in a 40x32 frame (80x64 screen). The collider is 52x36 screen px, unchanged; the sprite's bottom edge sits on the collider's bottom edge.

rig._comment: Joints in the cropped still's pixels (560x720). Four parts: the disc is the root (pivot at its centre so the aim and the stun tilt about it), the red glow under the rim is the lens (its own part so a pose can brighten it), the camera mast on top tilts with the aim, the rotor hangs from the mast top and wobbles in the hover. cast.md's gun barrel was not drawn; the camera mast stands in for it. The rotor and the mast carry non-uniform scales and the rotor an `attach` below its cut pivot: the still's tall helicopter rotor is flattened into a ring close to the disc.
